label: DetGS0 — Novelty Audit: deterministic dynamic 3DGS with exact optimizer/topology state consistency
idea: Single training framework where both per-Gaussian optimizer state (theta,m,v) and topology lineage (clone/split/prune) are preserved bit-exactly across densification, with deterministic (cross-run/cross-GPU reproducible) training.
prior_art_coverage: COMPLETE (3 arXiv sweeps + internal system characterization)

public_gap.nearest_public: Sparse Adam (modified sparse optimizer, no dense-equivalence); SkipGS (backward-compute skipping, not state); CAdam (modified moment estimator, no exactness)

determination: vs PUBLIC prior art: NO COLLISION on either exactness axis (confirmed public gap).
vs INTERNAL prior art: the UNIFIED claim is OCCUPIED by LAVOS0.
DetGS0 is NOT a de-novo novelty; its contribution is UNIFICATION under one correctness contract.
may_claim: First unified exact optimizer+topology state contract for dynamic 3DGS, subsuming VOS (optimizer) + ReproTopo (topology) + DPC (gradient determinism) under a single bitwise-correctness contract.
must_differentiate_from: LAVOS0 (same unified idea; LAVOS0 is a headroom-promotion gate, DetGS0 is the exactness-contract positioning)
